_comment: How-tos named but not written yet (review status absent), so the gaps are countable and the page shows each one dimmed in its category, 'Not written yet': a page that only shows what it has cannot tell you what it is missing (the Curriculum's principle, docs/design/how-to.md). Shape: schemas/how_to.toml [planned_fields]. Writing one means making data/how_to/<top category>/<id>.json with the same id and taking its line out of this list (the checker refuses an id in both, gate duplicate_id). The titles say what the reader is deciding or doing, in the words a person would search with; the facts arrive with the how-to, from primary sources, dated.
